summary: Bank of America stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet current valuation checks still point to a discount relative to an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model and to what earnings multiples imply. The share price has returned 111.1% over three years, which puts fresh focus on whether recent gains already reflect the underlying value of Bank of America.
